displayname: MY LITTLE PONY - Friendship is Magic
description: After being locked away in the moon for centuries, Nightmare Moon is set free and spreading night across Ponyville! Only Twilight Sparkle and her friends can free Ponyville from her grasp and bring light and friendship back to the land. Help them rebuild the town and reach their dreams in exciting quests! > Your favorite ponies are here: Rainbow Dash, Fluttershy, Applejack and more! > Make your Ponyville the most magical place in Equestria. > Play fun mini-games with your ponies: Ball Bounce, Apple-Picking and Magic Wings! > Enjoy official TV show voice talents featured in the game! _______...
